definition: An inequality in which the unknown appears only to the power $1$, such as $3x - 1 > 8$; you solve it like a linear equation, but reverse the sign if you multiply or divide both sides by a negative number.
The line on a graph where the two sides of an inequality in $x$ and $y$ are equal; it is drawn broken for $<$ or $>$ and solid for $\leqslant$ or $\geqslant$.
